name: Its Own Authority
overview: Scripture reveals that God's Word possesses inherent authority, remaining unbreakable and eternal despite the passing of time or changing circumstances. The law of the LORD is described as perfect and capable of restoring the soul, underscoring its divine reliability and power to impart wisdom. Jesus affirms that not even the smallest part of the law will disappear until all is fulfilled, emphasizing its enduring validity. Moreover, the word of God stands forever, unlike the fleeting nature of the world, confirming that Scripture carries its own sovereign authority beyond human influence.
